name: data-ml
description: Python (uv) starter for data and LLM features: golden-dataset evaluation harness with regression gate, versioned prompts, RAG with pgvector.

ml:test.run: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .

ml:eval.run: uv run python -m evals.run --cases evals/golden/example.jsonl --predict evals.example_model:predict --baseline evals/baseline.json --min-rate 0.8
